# Acme Vacation Policy

## Annual leave
Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Unused leave may be carried over,
up to a maximum of 5 days, and must be used before 31 March of the following year.

## Sick leave
Employees may take up to 10 days of paid sick leave per year. A medical certificate is required for absences
longer than 3 consecutive days.
